title: Optimization of the C2 substituents on the 1,4-bis(arylsulfonamido)naphthalene-N,N'-diacetic acid scaffold for better inhibition of Keap1-Nrf2 protein-protein interaction.
authors: Abed, Dhulfiqar Ali; Ali, Ahmed R; Lee, Sumi; Nguyen, Mai-Uyen; Verzi, Michael P; Hu, Longqin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子抑制剂阻断Keap1-Nrf2蛋白-蛋白相互作用，虽涉及Nrf2转录因子但核心是蛋白-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，且方法为湿实验与简单对接，无AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Direct inhibition of the protein-protein interaction (PPI) between Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) and nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) reduces the ubiquitination and subsequent degradation of Nrf2, leading to Nrf2 accumulation in the cytosol and the nuclear translocation of Nrf2. Once inside the nucleus, Nrf2 binds to and activates the expression of antioxidant response element (ARE) genes involved in redox homeostasis and detoxification. Herein, we report a series of 1,4-bis(arylsulfonamido)naphthalene-N,N'-diacetic acid analogs with varying C2 substituents to explore the structure-activity relationships at this position of the central naphthalene core. The Keap1-binding activities were first screened with a fluorescence polarization (FP) assay followed by further evaluation of the more potent compounds using a more sensitive time-resolved fluorescence energy transfer (TR-FRET) assay. It was found that compound 24a with C2-phthalimidopropyl group was the most potent in this series showing an IC(50) of 2.5 nM in the TR-FRET assay with a K(i) value in the subnanomolar range. Our docking study indicated that the C2-phthalimidopropyl group in compound 24a provided an extra hydrogen bonding interaction with the key residue Arg415 that may be responsible for the observed boost in binding affinity. In addition, compounds 12b, 15, and 24a were shown to activate the Nrf2 signaling pathway in NCM460D cells resulting in elevated mRNA levels of GSTM3, HMOX1 and NQO1 by 2.4-11.7 fold at 100 muM as compared to the vehicle control.
abstract_zh: 直接抑制Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）与核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）之间的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）可减少Nrf2的泛素化及其后续降解，导致Nrf2在细胞质中积累并发生核转位。一旦进入细胞核，Nrf2结合并激活参与氧化还原稳态和解毒作用的抗氧化反应元件（ARE）基因的表达。在此，我们报道了一系列具有不同C2取代基的1,4-双（芳基磺酰胺基）萘-N,N'-二乙酸类似物，以探讨中心萘核该位置上的构效关系。首先通过荧光偏振（FP）测定筛选Keap1结合活性，随后使用更灵敏的时间分辨荧光能量转移（TR-FRET）测定对活性更强的化合物进行进一步评估。结果发现，含有C2-邻苯二甲酰亚胺丙基的化合物24a在该系列中活性最强，在TR-FRET测定中IC(50)为2.5 nM，K(i)值处于亚纳摩尔范围。我们的对接研究表明，化合物24a中的C2-邻苯二甲酰亚胺丙基与关键残基Arg415提供了额外的氢键相互作用，这可能是观察到的结合亲和力提升的原因。此外，化合物12b、15和24a在NCM460D细胞中激活了Nrf2信号通路，与载体对照相比，在100 μM浓度下使GSTM3、HMOX1和NQO1的mRNA水平升高了2.4-11.7倍。
